purpose: Connect validity-aware alignment to a strict score-free full-reference oracle successor. Preserve unavailable evidence, bind active-duration configuration, and expose distinct future probability targets without selecting metrics or claiming calibration.

integration_contract.configuration_policy: The alignment payload alone cannot establish the producer's minimum-active-duration setting. The runner explicitly passes the selected mode to the bound producer, and the assembler independently checks support consistency against that declared mode. Neither a caller's declaration nor a structurally valid record proves waveform provenance.
integration_contract.missing_value_policy: Retain raw nullable diagnostics unchanged. Reject contradictory validity, channel status, reason projection or complete-channel summary claims. Never convert null to zero, one, an invalid numeric sentinel or an invented confidence interval.
integration_contract.input_origin_policy: The generic assembler does not infer synthetic, clean, never-lossy or legally eligible origin from an alignment record. Its output explicitly says input provenance is unverified. Only the bound synthetic runner declares how its own fixtures were constructed.
integration_contract.outcome_policy: Severity, correct-response probability, audible-condition probability, their intervals and every artifact component remain null. Prediction unit and population averaging remain unselected. No legacy class-level Brier/ECE/AUC gate is transferred to the response target.
integration_contract.metric_policy: No metric suite is selected by this integration. Metric execution stays unauthorized; no old two-family or ViSQOL-only gate is promoted to an active execution gate.

synthetic_inventory: Six-second orthogonal stereo identity, subtle mode
Six-second orthogonal stereo right-polarity inversion, subtle mode
Six-second orthogonal stereo right-channel dropout, subtle mode
Six-second mono identity with samples 4800 through 7199 zeroed, subtle mode
Six-second orthogonal stereo identity, quality-metric mode
Twelve-second orthogonal stereo identity by concatenating each six-second channel with itself, quality-metric mode
Stereo reference and mono test with explicit [L,R] versus [M] maps, subtle mode
fixture_boundary: Reuse the already consumed integer family from the bound channel/validity development implementation. The twelve-second concatenation is a declared numeric integration fixture, not a new natural source, independent group, perceptual stimulus or way to make a sparse real source eligible.
validation_requirements: Validate raw alignment shape, numeric types, explicit validity, configured support predicates, channel reason union and complete-channel aggregates before assembly.
Separate unsupported alignment from execution-blocked supported alignment; all oracle support remains false.
Preserve deep-copy isolation so later caller mutation cannot alter assembled evidence.

Reject missing-to-perfect coercion, forged supported status, dropped channel reasons, mode/configuration mismatch, stale record kind, malformed nested values and fabricated metric/human/uncertainty outputs.
Two complete byte-identical synthetic replays; independently check expected state transitions and known configured-duration boundaries.
Keep every declared construction and any failure visible; do not tune thresholds or repair a failed source outcome.
next_requirement: Real-data adoption still needs an exact source/execution checkpoint, target-matched normalization, metric/legal selection, human calibration and grouped validation. An internally consistent oracle envelope is not evidence that perceptual estimation works.
